H794.d: feminine of אֶשֶׁד; a ravine; springs.

H870.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to that of אֲתָרִים; a place; (adverb) after; after, place.

H928.d: from בָּהַל; panic, destruction; terror, trouble.

H953.d: from בּוּר (in the sense of בֹּאר); a pit hole (especially one used as a cistern or a prison); cistern, dungeon, fountain, pit, well.

H535.d: a primitive root; to droop; by implication to be sick, to mourn; languish, be weak, wax feeble.

H582.d: from אָנַשׁ; properly, a mortal (and thus differing from the more dignified אָדָם); hence,; a man in general (singly or collectively); another, [idiom] (blood-) thirsty, certain, chap(-man); divers, fellow, [idiom] in the flower of their age, husband, (certain, mortal) man, people, person, servant, some ([idiom] of them), [phrase] stranger, those, [phrase] their trade. It is often unexpressed in the English versions, especially when used in apposition with another word. Compare אִישׁ.

H747.d: of Persian origin; Arisai, a son of Haman; Arisai.

H923.d: from an unused root (probably meaning to glisten); white marble or perhaps alabaster; red (marble).

H534.d: apparently from אָמַר (in the sense of self-exaltation); a summit (of a tree or mountain); bough, branch.

H838.d: or אַשֻּׁר; from אָשַׁר in the sense of going; a step; going, step.

H678.d: from אָצַל (in its secondary sense of separation); an extremity (Isaiah 41:9), also a noble; chief man, noble.

H979.d: or בְּחוּרוֹת; feminine plural of בָּחוּר; also (masculine plural) בְּחֻרִים; youth (collectively and abstractly); young men, youth.

H956.d: (Aramaic) apparent denominative from בַּיִת; to lodge over night; pass the night.

H585.d: from אֲנָחָה; sighing; groaning, mourn, sigh.

H919.d: from בָּדַק; a gap or leak (in a building or a ship); breach, [phrase] calker.

H766.d: from the same as אֲרָן (in the sense of strength); the ash tree (from its toughness); ash.

H518.d: a primitive particle; used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not; (and, can-, doubtless, if, that) (not), [phrase] but, either, [phrase] except, [phrase] more(-over if, than), neither, nevertheless, nor, oh that, or, [phrase] save (only, -ing), seeing, since, sith, [phrase] surely (no more, none, not), though, [phrase] of a truth, [phrase] unless, [phrase] verily, when, whereas, whether, while, [phrase] yet.
r: should not be his and it came to pass when

H814.d: for שָׂכָר; a gratuity; gift, present.

H619.d: of uncertain derivation; Asnah, one of the Nethinim; Asnah.

H541.d: denominative from יָמִין; to take the right hand road; turn to the right. See אָמַן.

H875.d: from בָּאַר; a pit; especially a well; pit, well.

H668.d: probably of Egyptian derivation; a palanquin; chariot.

H687.d: from אָצַר; treasure; Etser, an Idumaean; Ezer.

H685.d: a variation from צְעָדָה; properly, a step-chain; by analogy, a bracelet; bracelet, chain.

H637.d: a primitive particle; meaning accession (used as an adverb or conjunction); also or yea; adversatively though; also, [phrase] although, and (furthermore, yet), but, even, [phrase] how much less (more, rather than), moreover, with, yea.
r: me and therefore have i also

H745.d: the same as אֲרִי; lion; Arjeh, an Israelite; Arieh.

H771.d: probably from אֹרֶן; strong; Ornan, a Jebusite; Ornan. See אֲרַוְנָה.

H754.d: (Aramaic) or אַרְכָּה; (Aramaic), from אֲרַךְ; length; lengthening, prolonged.

H710.d: a variation for אַרְגָּמָן; purple; purple.

H924.d: (Aramaic) from בְּהַל; a hurry; only adverb, hastily; in haste.

H861.d: (Aramaic) probably from the corresponding to אֵשׁ; probably a fire-place, i.e. furnace; furnace.

H801.d: the same as אֶשָּׁה, but used in a liturgical sense; properly, a burnt-offering; but occasionally of any sacrifice; (offering, sacrifice), (made) by fire.
r: according to the offerings made by fire

H815.d: from a root of uncertain signification; a tamarisk tree; by extension, a grove of any kind; grove, tree.

H935.d: a primitive root; to go or come (in a wide variety of applications); abide, apply, attain, [idiom] be, befall, [phrase] besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, [idiom] certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, [idiom] doubtless again, [phrase] eat, [phrase] employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch, [phrase] follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant, [phrase] have, [idiom] indeed, (in-) vade, lead, lift (up), mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, [idiom] (well) stricken (in age), [idiom] surely, take (in), way.

H941.d: the same as בּוּזִי; Buzi, an Israelite; Buzi.

H893.d: probably of foreign origin; Bebai, an Israelite; Bebai.

H812.d: the same as אֶשְׁכּוֹל; Eshcol, the name of an Amorite, also of a valley in Palestine; Eshcol.

H834.d: a primitive relative pronoun (of every gender and number); who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.; [idiom] after, [idiom] alike, as (soon as), because, [idiom] every, for, [phrase] forasmuch, [phrase] from whence, [phrase] how(-soever), [idiom] if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), [idiom] though, [phrase] until, [phrase] whatsoever, when, where ([phrase] -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, [phrase] whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.

H937.d: from בּוּז; disrespect; contempt(-uously), despised, shamed.

H540.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to אָמַן; {properly, to build up or support; to foster as a parent or nurse; figuratively to render (or be) firm or faithful, to trust or believe, to be permanent or quiet; morally to be true or certain}; believe, faithful, sure.

H586.d: (Aramaic) or אֲנַחְנָה; (Aramaic), corresponding to אֲנַחְנוּ; we; we.

H779.d: a primitive root; to execrate; [idiom] bitterly curse.
r: now therefore i pray thee curse

H899.d: from בָּגַד; a covering, i.e. clothing; also treachery or pillage; apparel, cloth(-es, ing), garment, lap, rag, raiment, robe, [idiom] very (treacherously), vesture, wardrobe.

H751.d: from אָרַךְ; length; Erek, a place in Babylon; Erech.

H581.d: (Aramaic) or (feminine) אִנִּיןlemma אֵנִּין first vowel, corrected to אִנִּין; (Aramaic), corresponding to הֵם; they; [idiom] are, them, these.

H874.d: a primitive root; to dig; by analogy, to engrave; figuratively, to explain; declare, (make) plain(-ly).

H799.d: from אֵשׁ and דָּת; a fire-law; fiery law.

H622.d: a primitive root; to gather for any purpose; hence, to receive, take away, i.e. remove (destroy, leave behind, put up, restore, etc.); assemble, bring, consume, destroy, felch, gather (in, together, up again), [idiom] generally, get (him), lose, put all together, receive, recover (another from leprosy), (be) rereward, [idiom] surely, take (away, into, up), [idiom] utterly, withdraw.

H509.d: a primitive root; to press; urge.

H596.d: a primitive root; to mourn, i.e. complain; complain.

H589.d: lemma אֲנַי second vowel, corrected to אֲנִי; contracted from אָנֹכִי; I; I, (as for) me, mine, myself, we, [idiom] which, [idiom] who.

H823.d: probably a variation for יְשָׁנָה; Ashnah, the name of two places in Palestine; Ashnah.

H631.d: a primitive root; to yoke or hitch; by analogy, to fasten in any sense, to join battle; bind, fast, gird, harness, hold, keep, make ready, order, prepare, prison(-er), put in bonds, set in array, tie.

H836.d: from אָשַׁר,; happy; Asher, a son of Jacob, and the tribe descended from him, with its territory; also a place in Palestine; Asher

H783.d: or אַרְתַּחְשַׁשְׁתְּא; or by permutation אַרְתַּחְשַׁסְתְּא; of foreign origin; Artachshasta (or Artaxerxes), a title (rather than name) of several Persian kings; Artaxerxes.

H933.d: from an unused root meaning to be pale; white scurf; freckled spot.

H780.d: of foreign origin; Ararat (or rather Armenia); Ararat, Armenia.

H720.d: an orthographical variation of אַרְוַד; fugitive; Arod, an Israelite; Arod.

H718.d: (Aramaic) probably akin to אֲלוּ; lo!; behold, lo.

H958.d: a primitive root; probably to cleave; spoil.

H817.d: from אָשַׁם; guilt; by implication, a fault; also a sin-offering; guiltiness, (offering for) sin, trespass (offering).

H809.d: feminine of אָשִׁישׁ; something closely pressed together, i.e. a cake of raisins or other comfits; flagon.

H991.d: the same as בֶּטֶן; Beten. a place in Palestine; Beten.

H884.d: from בְּאֵר and שֶׁבַע (in the sense of שָׁבַע); well of an oath; Beer-Sheba, a place in Palestine; Beer-shebah.

H729.d: a primitive root; to be firm; used only in the passive participle as a denominative from אֶרֶז; of cedar; made of cedar.

H599.d: a primitive root; to breathe hard, i.e. be enraged; be angry (displeased).

H722.d: patronymic from אַרְוָדִי; an Arodite or descendant of Arod; Arodi, Arodites.

H506.d: (Aramaic) or אֶלֶף; (Aramaic), corresponding to אֶלֶף; {hence (the ox's head being the first letter of the alphabet, and this eventually used as a numeral) a thousand}; thousand.

H795.d: from שָׁדַד; ravager; Ashdod, a place in Palestine; Ahdod.

H681.d: from אָצַל (in the sense of joining); a side; (as a preposition) near; at, (hard) by, (from) (beside), near (unto), toward, with. See also בֵּית הָאֵצֶל.

H832.d: patrial from אַשְׁקְלוֹן; Ashkelonite (collectively) or inhabitant of Ashkelon; Eshkalonites.

H698.d: feminine of אֹרֶב (only in the plural); ambuscades; spoils.

H789.d: patronymic from אַשְׁבֵּל; an Ashbelite (collectively) or descendant of Ashbel; Ashbelites.

H704.d: the same as אַרְבַּע; Arba, one of the Anakim; Arba.

H931.d: from an unused root apparently meaning to be thick; the thumb of the hand or great toe of the foot; thumb, great toe.

H860.d: probably from the same as אֵיתָן (in the sense of patience); a female donkey (from its docility); (she) ass.

H881.d: feminine plural of בְּאֵר; wells; Beeroth, a place in Palestine; Beeroth.

H828.d: of foreign origin; Ashpenaz, a Babylonian eunuch; Ashpenaz.

H904.d: or בִּגְתָנָא; of similar derivation to בִּגְתָא; Bigthan or Bigthana, a eunuch of Xerxes; Bigthan, Bigthana.

H645.d: or אֵפוֹא; from פֹּה; strictly a demonstrative particle, here; but used of time, now or then; here, now, where?

H839.d: contracted for תְּאַשּׁוּר; the cedar tree or some other light elastic wood; Ashurite.

H843.d: patronymic from אָשֵׁר; an Asherite (collectively) or descendant of Asher; Asherites.

H635.d: of Persian derivation; Ester, the Jewish heroine; Esther.

H825.d: from an unused root (probably meaning to lisp, i.e. practice enchantment); a conjurer; astrologer.

H896.d: (Aramaic) patrial from בַּבֶל; a Babylonian; Babylonia.

H938.d: the same as בּוּז; Buz, the name of a son of Nahor, and of an Israelite; Buz.

H593.d: from אָנָה and עַם; groaning of (the) people; Aniam, an Israelite; Aniam.

H846.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to אָשַׁר; a wall (from its uprightness); wall.

H765.d: from רָנַן; stridulous; Aran, an Edomite; Aran.

H796.d: patrial from אַשְׁדּוֹד; an Ashdodite (often collectively) or inhabitant of Asdod; Ashdodites, of Ashdod.

H971.d: another form of בַּחַן; a watch-tower of besiegers; tower.

H833.d: or אָשֵׁר; a primitive root; to be straight (used in the widest sense, especially to be level, right, happy); figuratively, to go forward, be honest, proper; (call, be) bless(-ed, happy), go, guide, lead, relieve.

H558.d: or אֲמַצְיָהוּ; from אָמַץ and יָהּ; strength of Jah; Amatsjah, the name of four Israelites; Amaziah.

H549.d: the same as אֲמָנָה; Amanah, a mountain near Damascus; Amana.

H775.d: probably of foreign origin; Arpakshad, a son of Noah; also the region settled by him; Arphaxad.

H850.d: probably from the same as שׁוּנִי; restful; Eshton, an Israelite; Eshton.

H767.d: the same as אֹרֶן; Oren, an Israelite; Oren.

H657.d: from אָפֵס; (sometimes like פָּעַל); cessation, i.e. an end (especially of the earth); often used adverb, no further; also the ankle (in the dual), as being the extremity of the leg or foot; ankle, but (only), end, howbeit, less than nothing, nevertheless (where), no, none (beside), not (any, -withstanding), thing of nought, save(-ing), there, uttermost part, want, without (cause).

H810.d: from an unused root (probably meaning to bunch together); a testicle (as a lump); stone.

H604.d: the same as אֲנָקָה; some kind of lizard, probably the gecko (from its wail); ferret.

H666.d: from the same as אֵפֶר (in the sense of covering); a turban; ashes.

H658.d: from אֶפֶס and the plural of דָּם; boundary of blood-drops; Ephes-Dammim, a place in Palestine; Ephes-dammim.

H830.d: or אַשְׁפּוֹת; or שְׁפֹת; (contraction) plural of a noun of the same form as אַשְׁפָּה, from שָׁפָה (in the sense of scraping); a heap of rubbish or filth; dung (hill).

H598.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to אָנַס; figuratively, to distress; trouble.

H852.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to אוֹת; a portent; sign.

H623.d: from אָסַף; collector; Asaph, the name of three Israelites, and of the family of the first; Asaph.

H546.d: feminine form of אֹמֶן (in its usual sense); adverb, surely; indeed.

H634.d: of foreign derivation; Esar-chaddon, an Assyrian king; Esar-haddon.

H633.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to אֱסָר in a legal sense; an interdict; decree.

H714.d: from an unused root probably meaning to wander; fugitive; Ard, the name of two Israelites; Ard.

H520.d: prolonged from אֵם; properly, a mother (i.e. unit of measure, or the fore-arm (below the elbow), i.e. a cubit; also a door-base (as a bond of the entrance); cubit, [phrase] hundred (by exchange for מֵאָה), measure, post.

H882.d: from בְּאֵר; fountained; Beeri, the name of a Hittite and of an Israelite; Beeri.

H530.d: or (shortened) אֱמֻנָה; feminine of אֵמוּן; literally firmness; figuratively security; morally fidelity; faith(-ful, -ly, -ness, (man)), set office, stability, steady, truly, truth, verily.
r: like unto thee or to thy faithfulness

H807.d: of foreign origin; Ashima, a deity of Hamath; Ashima.

H854.d: probably from אָנָה; properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc.; against, among, before, by, for, from, in(-to), (out) of, with. Often with another prepositional prefix.

H542.d: from אָמַן (in the sense of training); an expert; cunning workman.

H822.d: apparently from an unused root (probably meaning to leave interstices); a latticed window; casement, lattice.

H669.d: dual of masculine form of אֶפְרָת; double fruit; Ephrajim, a son of Joseph; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory; Ephraim, Ephraimites.

H756.d: (Aramaic) patrial from אֶרֶךְ; an Arkevite (collectively) or native of Erek; Archevite.

H522.d: the same as אַמָּה; Ammah, a hill in Palestine; Ammah.

H726.d: a clerical error for אֱדֹמִי; an Edomite (as in the margin); Syrian.

H880.d: the same as בְּאֵרָא; Beerah, an Israelite; Beerah.

H916.d: probably from בָּדַל; something in pieces, i.e. bdellium, a (fragrant) gum (perhaps amber); others a pearl; bdellium.

H831.d: probably from שָׁקַל in the sense of weighing-place (i.e. mart); Ashkelon, a place in Palestine; Ashkelon, Askalon.

H781.d: a primitive root; to engage for matrimony; betroth, espouse.

H553.d: a primitive root; to be alert, physically (on foot) or mentally (in courage); confirm, be courageous (of good courage, stedfastly minded, strong, stronger), establish, fortify, harden, increase, prevail, strengthen (self), make strong (obstinate, speed).
r: me for they were too strong

H942.d: probably of Persian origin; Bavvai, an Israelite; Bavai.

H897.d: a Persian word; food; spoil (from the margin for בַּז.)

H659.d: from an unused root probably meaning to breathe; properly, a breath, i.e. nothing; of nought.

H886.d: patrial from בְּאֵרוֹת; a Beerothite or inhabitant of Beeroth; Beerothite.

H566.d: from אִמֵּר; Imri, the name of two Israelites; Imri.

H521.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to אַמָּה; {properly, a mother (i.e. unit of measure, or the fore-arm (below the elbow), i.e. a cubit; also a door-base (as a bond of the entrance)}; cubit.

H871.d: plural from an unused root (probably meaning to step); places; Atharim, a place near Palestine; spies. b

H863.d: or אִיתַי; from אֵת; near; Ittai or Ithai, the name of a Gittite and of an Israelite; Ithai, Ittai.

H644.d: a primitive root; to cook, especially to bake; bake(-r, (-meats)).

H664.d: feminine of אֲפֵק; fortress; Aphekah, a place in Palestine; Aphekah.

H673.d: patrial from אֶפְרָת; an Ephrathite or an Ephraimite; Ephraimite, Ephrathite.

H865.d: or אִתְמוֹל; or אֶתְמוּל; probably from אֵת or אֵת and מוּל; heretofore; definitely yesterday; [phrase] before (that) time, [phrase] heretofore, of late (old), [phrase] times past, yester(day).

H557.d: from אָמַץ; strong; Amtsi, an Israelite; Amzi.

H829.d: of uncertain derivation; a measured portion; good piece (of flesh).

H567.d: probably a patronymic from an unused name derived from אָמַר in the sense of publicity, i.e. prominence; thus, a mountaineer; an Emorite, one of the Canaanitish tribes; Amorite.

H574.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to that of מֹתֶן; well-loined (i.e. burly) or mighty; terrible.

H716.d: patronymic from אַרְדְּ; an Ardite (collectively) or descendant of Ard; Ardites.

H964.d: from בָּזָה and יָהּ; contempts of Jah; Bizjothjah, a place in Palestine; Bizjothjah.

H715.d: from the same as אַרְדְּ; roaming; Ardon, an Israelite; Ardon.

H679.d: from אָצַל (in its primary sense of uniting); a joint of the hand (i.e. knuckle); also (according to some) a party-wall (Ezekiel 41:8); (arm) hole, great.

H945.d: the same as בּוּל (in the sense of rain); Bul, the eighth Hebrew month; Bul.

H695.d: from אָרַב; ambuscade; den, lie in wait.

H660.d: from אֵפַע (in the sense of hissing); an asp or other venomous serpent; viper.

H890.d: feminine of בְּאֹשׁ; stink-weed or any other noxious or useless plant; cockle.

H892.d: feminine active participle of an unused root meaning to hollow out; something hollowed (as a gate), i.e. pupil of the eye; apple (of the eye).

H684.d: from an unused root probably meaning to be strong; strength (i.e. strong); Otsem, the name of two Israelites; Ozem.

H639.d: from אָנַף; properly, the nose or nostril; hence, the face, and occasionally a person; also (from the rapid breathing in passion) ire; anger(-gry), [phrase] before, countenance, face, [phrase] forebearing, forehead, [phrase] (long-) suffering, nose, nostril, snout, [idiom] worthy, wrath.

H663.d: or אֲפִיק; from אָפַק (in the sense of strength); fortress; Aphek (or Aphik), the name of three places in Palestine; Aphek, Aphik.

H758.d: from the same as אַרְמוֹן; the highland; Aram or Syria, and its inhabitants; also the name of the son of Shem, a grandson of Nahor, and of an Israelite; Aram, Mesopotamia, Syria, Syrians.

H543.d: from אָמַן; sure; abstract, faithfulness; adverb, truly; Amen, so be it, truth.

H648.d: from the same as אָפֵל (in the sense of weakness); unripe; not grown up.

H808.d: from the same as אֵשׁ (in the sense of pressing down firmly; compare אֲשׁוּיָה); a (ruined) foundation; foundation.

H727.d: or אָרֹן; from אָרָה (in the sense of gathering); a box; ark, chest, coffin.
r: came to pass when the ark

H697.d: from רָבָה; a locust (from its rapid increase); grasshopper, locust.

H760.d: xlit ʼĂram Tsôbâh corrected to ʼĂram Tsôwbâh; from אֲרָם and צוֹבָא; Aram of Tsoba (or Coele-Syria); Aram-zobah.

H694.d: from אָרַב; ambush; Arab, a place in Palestine; Arab.

H918.d: a primitive root; to gap open; used only as a denominative from בֶּדֶק; to mend a breach; repair.

H638.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to אַף; {meaning accession (used as an adverb or conjunction); also or yea; adversatively though}; also.

H661.d: a primitive root; to surround; compass.

H617.d: the same as אַסִּיר; prisoner; Assir, the name of two Israelites; Assir.

H914.d: a primitive root; to divide (in variation senses literally or figuratively, separate, distinguish, differ, select, etc.); (make, put) difference, divide (asunder), (make) separate (self, -ation), sever (out), [idiom] utterly.

H654.d: from פָּלַל; judge; Ephlal, an Israelite; Ephlal.

H565.d: or אֶמְרָה; feminine of אֵמֶר, and meaning the same; {something said}; commandment, speech, word.

H601.d: from אָנַף; an unclean bird, perhaps the parrot (from its irascibility); heron.

H859.d: or (shortened); אַתָּ; or אַת; feminine (irregular) sometimes אַתִּי; plural masculine אַתֶּם; feminine אַתֶּן; or אַתֵּנָהlemma אתֵּנָה missing vowel, corrected to אַתֵּנָה; or אַתֵּנָּה; a primitive pronoun of the second person; thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you; thee, thou, ye, you.

H769.d: or אַרְנֹןlemma אַרְנן missing vowel, corrected to אַרְנֹן; from רָנַן; a brawling stream; the Arnon, a river east of the Jordan, also its territory; Arnon.

H724.d: or אֲרֻכָה; feminine passive participle of אָרַךְ (in the sense of restoring to soundness); wholeness (literally or figuratively); health, made up, perfected.

H514.d: xlit ʼEltᵉqê corrected to ʼEltᵉqêʼ; or (more properly) אֶלְתְּקֵה; of uncertain derivation; Eltekeh or Elteke, a place in Palestine; Eltekeh.

H603.d: from אָנַק; shrieking; crying out, groaning, sighing.

H961.d: feminine of בַּז; booty; prey, spoil.

H755.d: (Aramaic) from an unused root corresponding to רָכַב (in the sense of bending the knee); the knee; knee.

H784.d: a primitive word; fire (literally or figuratively); burning, fiery, fire, flaming, hot.

H857.d: or אָתָא; a primitive root (collateral to אוּת contraction); to arrive; (be-, things to) come (upon), bring.

H563.d: (Aramaic) perhaps from אֲמַר (in the sense of bringing forth); a lamb; lamb.

H688.d: from קִדָּה; burning, i.e. a carbuncle or other fiery gem; carbuncle.

H926.d: a primitive root; to tremble inwardly (or palpitate), i.e. (figuratively) be (causative, make) (suddenly) alarmed or agitated; by implication to hasten anxiously; be (make) affrighted (afraid, amazed, dismayed, rash), (be, get, make) haste(-n, -y, -ily), (give) speedy(-ily), thrust out, trouble, vex.

H835.d: from אָשַׁר; happiness; only in masculine plural construction as interjection, how happy!; blessed, happy.

H734.d: from אָרַח; a well-trodden road (literally or figuratively); also a caravan; manner, path, race, rank, traveller, troop, (by-, high-) way.

H560.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to אָמַר; {to say (used with great latitude)}; command, declare, say, speak, tell.

H683.d: from אָצַל and יָהּ prolonged; Jah has reserved; Atsaljah, an Israelite; Azaliah.

H609.d: of uncertain derivation; Asa, the name of a king and of a Levite; Asa.

H732.d: a primitive root; to travel; go, wayfaring (man).

H505.d: prop, the same as אֶלֶף; hence (the ox's head being the first letter of the alphabet, and this eventually used as a numeral) a thousand; thousand.
r: between you and it about two thousand

H997.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to בֵּין; {between (repeated before each noun, often with other particles); also as a conjunction, either...or}; among, between.

H583.d: the same as אֱנוֹשׁ; Enosh, a son of Seth; Enos.

H545.d: feminine of אֹמֶן (in the specific sense of training); tutelage; brought up.
r: like as when she was brought up

H655.d: from an unused root meaning to revolve; a turn, i.e. a season; [phrase] fitly.

H584.d: a primitive root; to sigh; groan, mourn, sigh.

H798.d: from the plural of אֲשֵׁדָה and פִּסְגָּה with the article interposed; ravines of the Pisgah; Ashdoth-Pisgah, a place east of the Jordan; Ashdoth-pisgah.

H572.d: from מָתַח; properly, something expansive, i.e. a bag; sack.

H561.d: from אָמַר; something said; answer, [idiom] appointed unto him, saying, speech, word.

H950.d: feminine passive participle of an unused root (meaning to be hollow); emptiness (as adjective); empty.

H955.d: feminine participle passive of בּוּשׁ; shame; shame.

H579.d: a primitive root (perhaps rather identical with אָנָה through the idea of contraction in anguish); to approach; hence, to meet in various senses; befall, deliver, happen, seek a quarrel.

H921.d: (Aramaic) corresponding (by transposition) to פָּרַד; to scatter; scatter.

H802.d: feminine of אִישׁ or אֱנוֹשׁ; irregular plural, נָשִׁים;(used in the same wide sense as אֱנוֹשׁ); a woman; (adulter) ess, each, every, female, [idiom] many, [phrase] none, one, [phrase] together, wife, woman. Often unexpressed in English.

r: came to pass in the fortieth

H620.d: of foreign derivation; Osnappar, an Assyrian king; Asnapper.

H717.d: a primitive root; to pluck; gather, pluck.

H670.d: (Aramaic) of foreign origin (only in the plural); an Apherasite or inhabitant of an unknown region of Assyria; Apharsite.

H501.d: from אֵל and עָשָׂה; God has made; Elasah, the name of four Israelites; Elasah, Eleasah.

H701.d: patrial from אֲרָב; an Arbite or native of Arab; Arbite.

H576.d: (Aramaic) or אֲנָה; (Aramaic), corresponding to אֲנִיlemma אֲנַי second vowel, corrected to אֲנִי; I; I, as for me.

H913.d: from בָּדַל; alloy (because removed by smelting); by analogy, tin; [phrase] plummet, tin.

H902.d: probably of foreign origin; Bigvai, an Israelite; Bigvai.

H643.d: apparently of foreign derivation; a pavilion or palace-tent; palace.

H908.d: a primitive root; (figuratively) to invent; devise, feign.

H656.d: a primitive root; to disappear, i.e. cease; be clean gone (at an end, brought to nought), fail.

H929.d: from an unused root (probably meaning to be mute); properly, a dumb beast; especially any large quadruped or animal (often collective); beast, cattle.

H665.d: from an unused root meaning to bestrew; ashes; ashes.

H693.d: a primitive root; to lurk; (lie in) ambush(-ment), lay (lie in) wait.
r: against me to lie in wait

H891.d: plural of בְּאֹשׁ; poison-berries; wild grapes.

H740.d: xlit ʼĂrîʼêl corrected to ʼĂrîyʼêl; the same as אֲרִיאֵל; Ariel, a symbolical name for Jerusalem, also the name of an Israelite; Ariel.

H550.d: or אֲמִינוֹן; from אָמַן; faithful; Amnon (or Aminon), a son of David; Amnon.

H616.d: for אָסִיר; {bound, i.e. a captive}; prisoner.

H607.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to אַתָּה; thou; as for thee, thou.

H774.d: from רָפַד; spread out; Arpad, a place in Syria; Arpad, Arphad.

H671.d: (Aramaic) or אֲפַרְסַתְכַי; (Aramaic), of foreign origin (only in the plural); an Apharsekite or Apharsathkite, an unknown Assyrian tribe; Apharsachites, Apharasthchites.

H728.d: or (by transposition) אוֹרְנָה; or אַרְנִיָּהlemma אַנִיָּה missing resh, corrected to אַרְנִיָּה; all by orthographical variation for אׇרְנָן; Aravnah (or Arnijah or Ornah), a Jebusite; Araunah.

H773.d: (Aramaic) feminine of אֲרַע; the bottom; bottom.

H995.d: a primitive root; to separate mentally (or distinguish), i.e.(generally) understand; attend, consider, be cunning, diligently, direct, discern, eloquent, feel, inform, instruct, have intelligence, know, look well to, mark, perceive, be prudent, regard, (can) skill(-full), teach, think, (cause, make to, get, give, have) understand(-ing), view, (deal) wise(-ly, man).

H628.d: by reduplication from אָסֻף; gathered up together, i.e. a promiscuous assemblage (of people); mixt multitude.

H975.d: from בָּחַן (in the sense of keeping a look-out); a watch-tower; tower.

H948.d: from an unused root (of the same form) meaning to bleach, i.e. (intransitive) be white; probably cotton (of some sort); fine (white) linen.

H811.d: or אֶשְׁכֹּל; probably prolonged from אֶשֶׁךְ; a bunch of grapes or other fruit; cluster (of grapes).

H968.d: of Persian origin; Biztha, a eunuch of Xerxes; Biztha.

H806.d: probably from שָׁחַר; black; Ashchur, an Israelite; Ashur.

H957.d: from בָּזַז; plunder; booty, prey, spoil(-ed).

H507.d: the same as אֶלֶף; Eleph, a place in Palestine; Eleph.

H552.d: an orthographical variation of אׇמְנָם; {verily}; in (very) deed; of a surety.

H949.d: from the same as בּוּץ; shining; Botsets, a rock near Michmash; Bozez.

H856.d: from אֵת and בַּעַל; with Baal; Ethbaal, a Phoenician king; Ethbaal.

H987.d: feminine plural from בָּטַח; security; secure.

H512.d: patrial from a name of uncertain derivation; an Elkoshite or native of Elkosh; Elkoshite.

H600.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to אַף (only in the plural as a singular); the face; face, visage.

H692.d: from אֶרְאֵל; heroic; Areli (or an Arelite, collectively), an Israelite and his descendants; Areli, Arelites.

H841.d: from the same as אֲשַׂרְאֵל; right toward God; Asarelah, an Israelite; Asarelah. Compare יְשַׂרְאֵלָה.

H526.d: the same as אָמוֹן; Amon, the name of three Israelites; Amon.

H820.d: probably from שֶׁמֶן; a fat-field; desolate place.

H848.d: patrial from אֶשְׁתָּאֹל; an Eshtaolite (collectively) or inhabitant of Eshtaol; Eshtaulites.

H909.d: a primitive root; to divide, i.e. (reflex.) be solitary; alone.

H969.d: xlit bâchôwnʼ corrected to bâchôwn; from בָּחַן; an assayer or metals; tower.

H757.d: patrial from another place (in Palestine) of similar name with אֶרֶךְ; an Arkite or native of Erek; Archi, Archite.

H868.d: the same as אֶתְנָה; a gift (as the price of harlotry or idolatry); hire, reward.

H840.d: by orthographical variation from אָשַׁר and אֵל; right of God; Asarel, an Israelite; Asareel.

H753.d: from אָרַךְ; length; [phrase] forever, length, long.

H519.d: apparently a primitive word; a maidservant or female slave; (hand-) bondmaid(-woman), maid(-servant).

H676.d: from the same as צֶבַע (in the sense of grasping); something to sieze with, i.e. a finger; by analogy, a toe; finger, toe.

H994.d: perhaps from בָּעָה (in the sense of asking); properly, a request; used only adverbially (always with 'my Lord'); oh that!; with leave, or if it please; alas, O, oh.

H594.d: probably from an unused root meaning to be narrow; according to most a plumb-line, and to others a hook; plumb-line

H680.d: a primitive root; properly, to join; used only as a denominative from אֵצֶל; to separate; hence, to select, refuse, contract; keep, reserve, straiten, take.
r: thee there and i will take

H972.d: from בָּחַר; select; choose, chosen one, elect.

H851.d: or אֶשְׁתְּמוֹעַ; or אֶשְׁתְּמֹה; from שָׁמַע (in the sense of obedience); Eshtemoa or Eshtemoh, a place in Palestine; Eshtemoa, Eshtemoh.

H595.d: sometimes, aw-no'-kee; a primitive pronoun; I; I, me, [idiom] which.

H910.d: from בָּדַד; separate; adverb, separately; alone, desolate, only, solitary.

H819.d: feminine of אָשָׁם; guiltiness, a fault, the presentation of asin-offering; offend, sin, (cause of) trespass(-ing, offering).
r: this thing why will he be a cause of trespass
hither for whereas we have offended

H610.d: from סוּךְ; anointed, i.e. an oil-flask; pot.

H911.d: from בָּדַד; separation; Bedad, an Edomite; Bedad.

H973.d: a primitive root; to loath; abhor, get hastily (from the margin for בָּהַל).

H887.d: a primitive root; to smell bad; figuratively, to be offensive morally; (make to) be abhorred (had in abomination, loathsome, odious), (cause a, make to) stink(-ing savour), [idiom] utterly.
r: me to make me to stink

H862.d: or אַתִּיק; from נָתַק in the sense of decreasing; a ledge or offset in abuilding; gallery.

H647.d: perhaps from פּוּחַ; breeze; Aphiach, an Israelite; Aphiah.

H793.d: from an unused root meaning to pour; an outpouring; stream.

H730.d: from אָרַז; a cedar tree (from the tenacity of its roots); cedar (tree).

H614.d: or אָסִף; from אָסַף; gathered, i.e. (abstractly) a gathering in of crops; ingathering.

H818.d: from אָשַׁם; guilty; hence, presenting asin-offering; one which is faulty, guilty.

H970.d: or בָּחֻר; participle passive of בָּחַר; properly, selected, i.e. a youth (often collective); (choice) young (man), chosen, [idiom] hole.

H691.d: probably for אֲרִיאֵל; a hero (collectively); valiant one.

H503.d: denominative from אֶלֶף; causative, to make athousandfold; bring forth thousands.

H813.d: of foreign origin; Ashkenaz, a Japhethite, also his descendants; Ashkenaz.

H738.d: or (prolonged) [ar-yay']; from אָרָה (in the sense of violence); a lion; (young) lion, [phrase] pierce (from the margin).

H568.d: or prolonged אֲמַרְיָהוּ; from אָמַר and יָהּ; Jah has said (i.e. promised); Amarjah, the name of nine Israelites; Amariah.

H650.d: from אָסַף; properly, containing, i.e. a tube; also a bed or valley of astream; also a strong thing or a hero; brook, channel, mighty, river, [phrase] scale, stream, strong piece.
r: also unto thee for the rivers

H652.d: from the same as אָפֵל; dusk; darkness, obscurity, privily.

H866.d: from תָּנָה; a present (as the price of harlotry); reward.

H719.d: probably from רוּד; a refuge for the roving; Arvad, an island-city of Palestine; Arvad.

H529.d: from אָמַן; established, i.e. (figuratively) trusty; also (abstractly) trustworthiness; faith(-ful), truth.

H782.d: from אָרַשׂ (in the sense of desiring to possess); a longing for; request.

H615.d: from אָסַר; bound, i.e. a captive; (those which are) bound, prisoner.
